resources.string: 1. Install Shizuku from its official download page. ClipHistory uses its non-root mode to save clipboard text while this app is closed.
2. Connect to Wi-Fi. In Android Settings, enable Developer options if needed, then enable Wireless debugging. The official guide explains where these settings are on your phone.
3. Open Shizuku and choose Pairing. In Wireless debugging, choose Pair device with pairing code. Enter Android’s code in Shizuku. Allow Shizuku notifications if its pairing flow asks for them.
4. In Shizuku, tap Start and wait for it to say that it is running. Pairing and starting are separate steps.

5. Return here and tap Connect. Allow ClipHistory to use Shizuku, then run the Connection test. Recording stores text locally until it rolls out of your chosen limit or you delete it. Pause before copying private text that another app might not mark sensitive.
